title: Rescuing a flying-fox stuck on a balcony:  this is Juliette
description:
Juliette is an adult female Grey-Headed Flying-Fox who crash landed on a tiny balcony, from which she couldn't fly out or escape.
She has hit her head mildly and after 24 hours she was ready to hang with the other batties so I moved her along.  
And, she's pregnant.  If she's OK in a few days she will go to the release aviary for release this cycle so she can go out and have her baby out in the wild or she will be hard released so she can go straight back to the wild.  It depends on how quickly she recovers.
author: Megabattie
